Changing Electricity Markets: Quantifying the Price Effects of Greening the Energy Matrix
abstract: We analyse the drivers of European Power Exchange (EPEX) wholesale electricity prices between 2012 and early 2022 using machine learning. The agnostic random forest approach that we use is able to reduce in-sample root mean square errors (RMSEs) by around 50% when compared to a standard linear least square model − indicating that non-linearities and interaction effects are key in wholesale electricity markets. Out-of- sample prediction errors using machine learning are (slightly) lower than even in-sample least square errors using a least square model. The effects of efforts to limit power consumption and green the energy matrix on wholesale electricity prices are first order. CO2 permit prices strongly impact electricity prices, as do the prices of source energy commodities. And carbon permit prices’ impact has clearly increased post-2021 (particularly for baseload prices). Among energy sources, natural gas has the largest effect on electricity prices. Importantly, the role of wind energy feed-in has slowly risen over time, and its impact is now roughly on par with that of coal.
abstract_zh: 我们利用机器学习分析了2012年至2022年初欧洲电力交易所（EPEX）批发电价的驱动因素。我们采用的无先验假设的随机森林方法，与标准线性最小二乘模型相比，可将样本内均方根误差（RMSE）降低约50%，这表明非线性和交互效应在批发电力市场中至关重要。使用机器学习得到的样本外预测误差，甚至（略）低于使用最小二乘模型得到的样本内误差。限制电力消费和能源结构绿色化的努力对批发电价的影响是一阶的。二氧化碳排放配额价格对电价有强烈影响，能源原料价格同样如此。而且，碳排放配额价格的影响在2021年后明显增强（尤其是对基荷电价）。在各类能源中，天然气对电价的影响最大。重要的是，风电上网电量的作用随时间缓慢上升，目前其影响与煤电大致相当。

title: Quantifying the Role of Interest Rates, the Dollar and Covid in Oil Prices
abstract: This study analyses oil price movements through the lens of an agnostic random forest model, which is based on 1,000 regression trees. It shows that this highly disciplined, yet flexible computational model reduces in-sample root mean square errors (RMSEs) by 65% relative to a standard linear least square model that uses the same set of 11 explanatory factors. In forecasting exercises the RMSE reduction ranges between 51% and 68%, highlighting the relevance of non-linearities in oil markets. The results underscore the importance of incorporating financial factors into oil models: US interest rates, the dollar and the VIX together account for 39% of the models’ RMSE reduction in the post-2000 sample, rising to 48% in the post-2020 sample. If COVID-19 is also considered as a risk factor, these shares become even larger.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过一个无先验假设的随机森林模型分析油价变动，该模型基于1,000棵回归树。研究表明，这一高度规范但又灵活的计算模型，相对于使用相同11个解释因子的标准线性最小二乘模型，可将样本内均方根误差（RMSE）降低65%。在预测练习中，RMSE的降幅在51%至68%之间，突显了非线性在石油市场中的重要性。结果强调了将金融因素纳入石油模型的重要性：在2000年后样本中，美国利率、美元和VIX合计解释了模型RMSE降幅的39%，在2020年后样本中这一比例升至48%。如果将新冠疫情也视为风险因素，这些比例会更大。

title: Growth, Coal and Carbon Emissions: Economic Overheating and Climate Change
abstract: We use a comprehensive database of 121 countries over the 1971-2016 period to study how macroeconomic factors drive carbon (carbon-dioxide) emissions. For this purpose, dynamic panel regressions are estimated. Carbon emissions rise with economic development, manufacturing activity, urbanization and increasingly with economic growth. In electricity generation, the use of coal, and to a lesser degree of oil, is associated with higher carbon emissions, while renewable energy use is already associated with lower national emissions in advanced economies. We also uncover a non-linearity: economic overheating is particularly harmful when coal use is more intensive. The results suggest that mitigating economic cycles might also reduce carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们利用121个国家1971至2016年的综合数据库，研究宏观经济因素如何驱动碳（二氧化碳）排放。为此，我们估计了动态面板回归模型。碳排放随经济发展、制造业活动、城市化以及经济增长而上升，且增速日益加快。在发电领域，煤炭的使用，以及程度稍轻的石油的使用，与较高的碳排放相关，而在发达经济体中，可再生能源的使用已与较低的国家排放相关。我们还发现了一种非线性关系：当煤炭使用较为密集时，经济过热的危害尤为严重。结果表明，平抑经济周期也可能减少碳排放。
